title: Design D-pad 10-foot TV navigation and realtime voice-agent turn-taking with hardware constraints

contextSnapshot.surface: living-room TV media app with paired realtime voice assistant
contextSnapshot.platform: Compose for TV / tvOS and WebRTC realtime voice agent

prompt: Design a 10-foot TV catalog screen and paired realtime voice-agent search flow that handles D-pad spatial focus, barge-in interruptions, and voice-triggered purchases safely.
forbiddenBehaviors: assumes mouse hover or touch scrollbars on a 10-foot TV layout
ignores overscan safe zones or loses D-pad focus when returning from a detail view
executes irreversible voice purchases without explicit confirmation or keeps full unsaid assistant text in transcript after barge-in

rubricDimensions.pass: uses visible focus rings/scale within overscan safe margins, predictable D-pad focus restoration, and viewing-distance type scale
rubricDimensions.fail: transplants mobile/web cards with tiny text or broken directional focus

rubricDimensions.pass: handles VAD/barge-in with assistant-transcript truncation, visible mic/listening state, latency masking for tool calls, and confirmation for destructive or paid actions
rubricDimensions.fail: treats voice as static command-slot text without interruption handling or confirmation guardrails

negativeControls.name: desktop browser preview as TV proof
negativeControls.input: the 1920x1080 layout looks clean on a laptop monitor with mouse clicks
negativeControls.mustNot: claim 10-foot legibility or D-pad focus behavior is verified from mouse-only laptop testing

baseline.withoutSkill: shrinks a web dashboard onto 16:9 with hover states, ignores overscan and focus restoration, and omits barge-in truncation and voice purchase confirmation
baseline.withSkill: applies 10-foot safe geometry, Compose for TV/tvOS focus idioms, realtime voice barge-in/privacy rules, and explicit not-checked hardware labels
